subject: Gemini same-chat text preflight: user mode approval rechecked, still new-chat gated
body: Ziggy answered the prior question: Temporarily deselect and restore Videos, for one text inquiry in the SAME e6a2bab576bff5a3 chat, no render. I applied that authorized attempt once. Gemini again displayed Start a new chat? and said selecting the tool will start a new chat. I closed the notice; original URL/Videos mode and empty composer remain. No inquiry, new chat, upload, render or applied settings change. Approval is valid but cannot be performed with the required same-context boundary. A separate text chat would not establish access to the original video chat. No fresh permission question or new generation was issued. Evidence and exact action counts are in the linked followup audit; prior audit remains unchanged.
